description: Compact label to convey category, quantity or state.

howToUse: Use it for a short label next to something: state ("Paid"), category ("Design"), count ("12").
Choose the `tone` by meaning: success, warning, danger, info or neutral. Write the state in the text too, not only in the color.
Add `dot` for a state that changes, such as online or offline.
alternatives: Something people click to filter or remove: Chip.
A message that needs a sentence: Callout.

keyboard.action: The badge does not receive focus. Screen readers read its text with the content around it.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
